toolSettingsChangelogText:
🎉 Now compatible with multiple SiYuan installation methods including desktop and Docker; provides both MCP and CLI connection options.
`v0.4.0` — Document Timeline version control for per-document snapshot comparison and rollback; redesigned tool settings panel with accordion layout.
`v0.3.8` — Slimmer MCP output reduces context usage; settings page structure was improved with a new Debug panel for troubleshooting.
`v0.3.7` — New `fs` filesystem-style tool lets AI work with notes like Markdown files while hiding SiYuan's internal blocks, document tree, and ID structure.
addTopBarIcon: Add a top bar icon by plugin
confirmRemove: Confirm to delete the data in ${name}?
getTab: Print out all opened custom tabs in the debugger
debug_slimResponses_desc: Return only the data an agent usually needs. Turn this off to inspect full debug fields, pagination internals, UI refresh metadata, and raw helper metadata.
version_control_show_debug_meta_desc: Show document/block IDs and raw diff statuses such as unchanged and modified in the document timeline. Off by default to reduce noise.
timeline_action_rollback_document: Roll back whole document to history
timeline_auto_collapsed_title: The window is narrow, so the timeline was collapsed automatically
timeline_loading_current_diff: Creating current version and loading diff...
timeline_empty_select_node: Select a timeline node on the right to compare its historical version with the current state
timeline_empty_unparseable_file: This file is empty, or the current snapshot content cannot be parsed into displayable blocks yet.
timeline_old_missing_for_added: New in current state, no historical content
timeline_new_missing_for_removed: Existed in history, deleted in current state
timeline_old_content_empty_fallback: Left-side version is empty or cannot be parsed
timeline_new_content_empty_fallback: Right-side version is empty or cannot be parsed
timeline_accept_reason_complex_block: Complex blocks can only be viewed or restored by rolling back the whole document
timeline_msg_name_required: Enter a timeline node name first
timeline_msg_block_restore_unsupported: This block does not support block-level rollback yet
timeline_msg_no_rollback_version: This timeline node has no left-side version to roll back to
timeline_msg_document_rolled_back: Document rolled back to the historical version
timeline_confirm_rollback_block: Roll back this block in "${title}" to the left-side historical version?
timeline_confirm_rollback_document: This will roll back the whole document to the left-side historical version. Continue?
timeline_error_current_snapshot_not_foun: Current-state snapshot was created, but it could not be located
timeline_error_new_snapshot_not_found: Snapshot was created, but the new snapshot could not be located
timeline_error_no_restore_position: Cannot identify a safe restore position for the deleted block
timeline_error_restore_removed_block_fai: Failed to restore the deleted block

connectionOverviewDesc: This page provides two connection types: MCP and CLI.
connectionOverviewMcp: MCP: connect SiYuan from MCP-capable clients.
connectionOverviewCli: CLI: run `siyuan-sisyphus` commands directly from a terminal or script.
mcpGuideDesc: Recommended connection methods for different SiYuan installation scenarios.
mcpHttpGuideDesc: Best for desktop direct connections, WSL, LAN access, and cross-machine access. Enabling TLS turns this into HTTPS.
mcpStdioGuideDesc: Best for Docker / remote deployments, or when the client can only launch MCP via stdio.
mcpClientPresetsNote: Choose a client and connection type, then copy the matching format. HTTP/HTTPS uses the current server URL; stdio uses mcp-server.cjs from the current SiYuan plugin directory.
mcpPresetCherryDesc: Copy mcpServers JSON config for Cherry Studio Settings -> MCP Servers.
mcpPresetCcSwitchDesc: Copy CC Switch server-map JSON config.
mcpPresetGenericDesc: Copy common mcpServers JSON used by many MCP clients.
mcpStdioNote: Note: stdio usually serves one client connection at a time, and it should be preferred for Docker deployments.
cliGuideDesc: The CLI connects to SiYuan over the HTTP API directly and does not require the MCP server. Best for terminal, scripts, and automation.
cliGuideInstallDesc: Install the published command-line package globally.
cliGuideInitDesc: Create the local config file with API URL and token.
cliGuideVerifyDesc: Run a simple command to confirm connectivity.
cliGuideHelpDesc: List tools and inspect action help from the terminal.
httpUnsupported: HTTP server is only available in the SiYuan desktop app.
httpWarnExposedNoAuth: ⚠️ Bound to a non-loopback address with auth disabled. Other devices on the network can access your SiYuan workspace.
analyticsEmpty: No analytics data yet. Start using MCP tools to see usage statistics.
analyticsTokenApproxHint: Approximate token counts based on observed text length; MCP first-connection cost is shown separately from per-call averages.
analyticsRecentCallsHint: Shows the latest 100 local calls with captured input/output text and approximate token counts.
analyticsRecentMissingText: Not captured for this legacy event.
telemetry_enabled_desc: Send aggregated usage statistics to help improve the MCP plugin. No note content, IDs, or paths are ever uploaded.
telemetry_interval_desc: How often to send a telemetry report.
telemetry_endpoint_desc: Optional HTTPS endpoint for aggregated telemetry. Leave empty to disable all telemetry uploads.
telemetryHint: Telemetry sends only aggregated statistics (call counts, error rates, average durations). No note content, IDs, or paths are ever included.
